brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates thorough responsibility-chain completion with no serious errors. RC1-RC8 are met through systematic symptom screening, risk explanation, timeline clarification, medication safety management, and an executable action plan. HO1 (timeline reconstruction) is complete with 5+ phases mapped. HO2 (privacy barrier navigation) is complete with respectful information gathering despite patient reluctance. HO4 (dynamic reprioritization) is complete with medication urgency escalation. The doctor actively used workspace queries, verified medications through multiple channels, and maintained continuous follow-up over 18 hours with clear teach-back and emergency thresholds.
